name: nested_push_pop_assumption_lifetime
derivation: Added finite script motivated by src/test/sat_user_scope.cpp's active-formula coherence invariant. Base p or q is SAT. Frame not p remains SAT. Nested not q is UNSAT. Pop removes not q.
